page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. It features 64 physical cores and 64 vCPUs using the arm64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The CPU allocation is fully dedicated, with a single thread per core configuration running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the server includes 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. This local storage is bundled directly with the hardware configuration, offering high-capacity local data access.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 34 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture and dedicated core model provide high compute density per watt and resource unit, making it a viable option for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance and local NVMe storage without the overhead of hyperthreading.

Appropriate workloads for this configuration include compute-heavy applications, distributed data processing, local database hosting, containerized microservices, and arm64-native build and test pipelines.
